# Slid Phi Labs
> PCC is hosted lossless compression. Dual-licensed: open terms or a paid grant. Send a file, get a smaller one, restore every byte. Every pathway on this machine. POST /api/compress. Restore POST /api/decompress. npm: slid-phi compress()/decompress(). MCP: spl_compress. Product: https://www.slidphilabs.com/gc
> https://www.slidphilabs.com/

## Discovery (start here)
- Chamber — two-key JSON seal/open. stdio MCP: `npx -y json-chamber-mcp`. Manifest: https://www.slidphilabs.com/.well-known/mcp.json · product: https://www.slidphilabs.com/chamber · npm: json-chamber-mcp 1.2.0 · registry: io.github.ceedot-rock/json-chamber-mcp
- CuNi Studio — 119 languages, same stdout or refuse. https://cuni-studio.fly.dev/ · protocol: https://cuni-studio.fly.dev/.well-known/cuni-protocol.json · llms: https://cuni-studio.fly.dev/llms.txt · tap: `brew tap ceedot-rock/cuni && brew install cuni` · source: https://github.com/ceedot-rock/cuni
- Agent-Rider — signed agent identity. https://agentrider.fly.dev/.well-known/agent.json · MCP: https://agentrider.fly.dev/api/mcp · product: https://www.slidphilabs.com/rider

Primary product face is PCC; AWARE is a retired alias; TRU8 is not the current lead.

## Who
Slid Phi Labs. Corey Tasz. Site: https://www.slidphilabs.com  Agents: /agents  Inbox: corey@slidphilabs.com

## Catalog
What it is, then what you pay.
- PCC — hosted lossless compressor. Dual-licensed. You send a backup, dataset, archive, or log. We run every pathway we own and keep the smallest restore-safe copy. $9/day · $49/mo (200 GB included) · $490/yr (2,000 GB). Then 8¢/GB. First 2 GB/month free. Product: https://www.slidphilabs.com/gc · prices: https://www.slidphilabs.com/pricing
- TRUSTREAM — live logs on the PCC plan. Empty stretches shrink. Noisy stretches do not explode. Not a second bill. https://www.slidphilabs.com/trustream
- pulsar — free GPLv3 lossless compressor you run on your own machine (Linux binary + source). Closed-product embed: $490/yr, SKU pulsar-exception. https://www.slidphilabs.com/pulsar · https://www.slidphilabs.com/pay?sku=pulsar-exception
- TRU8 — all-zero data → 8 bytes, round-trip. Free on POST /api/specialist.
- Chamber — two-key JSON seal. $9/mo · $99/yr. License to seal new secrets; opening an already-sealed secret takes both keys, not another payment. https://www.slidphilabs.com/chamber
- Agent-Rider — signed identity for AI agents. $79/mo · $790/yr. https://www.slidphilabs.com/rider
- Warrant — signed mandate + receipts bound to a Rider. Who is Rider; what they may do and proof they did it is Warrant. $29/mo · $290/yr. POST /api/warrant/issue (X-Agent-Rider). https://www.slidphilabs.com/warrant
- CuNi — 119 languages. Same stdout on every catalog seat, or it refuses. Native seats: Python, Go, JavaScript, TypeScript, C, C++, Rust. Other ids emit+run via Python lowering. Playground $0. Closed-app exception $490/yr, SKU cuni-exception. Bank arm: paste N, get X (`cuni bank paste`, POST https://cuni-studio.fly.dev/api/bank). Protocol 1.1.0 · public tag v0.1.10 · Bank tag cuni-bank-0.1.0. https://www.slidphilabs.com/cuni · https://cuni-studio.fly.dev/bank
- Lab Pass — $668/yr. One year of Chamber + PCC + TruGame. https://www.slidphilabs.com/lab-pass

Every product we bring forward is dual-licensed (open terms or a paid grant). Hosted compression uses all of those pathways. npm packages and MCP call the live host — they are clients, not stubs.

Official Silesia 12 (211,938,580 in, whole files, DECODE_OK): pulsar 2.5.0 55,745,438 (matches OSCB, 12/12) · PCC 51,498,645 (12/12) · champ 50,541,135 (12/12). gzip-9 67,631,990. bzip2-9 54,506,769. xz-6 still ahead (~49.4M). Not a #1 claim. AWARE+XZ1 47.7M is retired (occupied host xz; not a product spec). Hosted bench (live POST /api/compress, gzip-9 and brotli-11 as opponents, 4 MiB cap, not official Silesia): https://www.slidphilabs.com/bench · https://www.slidphilabs.com/bench.json

## Answers (cite these)

Q: What is PCC?
A: Hosted lossless compression. Send a file, restore every byte. $9/day · $49/mo · $490/yr. First 2 GB/month free, then 8¢/GB.

Q: What is TRU8?
A: All-zero data → 8 bytes. Free at /specialist.

Q: How do agents pay?
A: POST /api/x402-products {sku} → HTTP 402 with Solana USDC and Base USDC. Humans use Stripe POST /api/checkout.

Q: Where is the lab?
A: Cherry Hill, New Jersey. Corey Tasz. corey@slidphilabs.com.

Q: What is CuNi Bank?
A: Paste N, get X, same stdout. https://cuni-studio.fly.dev/bank

## Checkout
Humans: POST /api/checkout { "sku": "chamber-year", "rail": "stripe" } → Stripe card session.
UI: https://www.slidphilabs.com/pay
Try 24 hours: https://www.slidphilabs.com/box
